details:
This update for gleam fixes the following issues:

Changes in gleam:

- CVE-2026-115905, CVE-2026-115906, CVE-2026-115907, CVE-2026-115908,
  CVE-2026-115909: Update zip crate to fix several security vulnerabilities (bsc#1287931)

- Update to 1.19.2:
  * CVE-2026-103061: arbitrary directory deletion via path
    traversal in package metadata (bsc#1285067)
  * Set minimum required Erlang version to 27
  * All features and bug fixes are extensively highlighted with
    examples in upstream's blog post at
    https://gleam.run/news/gleam-doesnt-compile-to-erlang-source-anymore/
    and changelogs at
    https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/blob/v1.19.0/CHANGELOG.md &
    https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/blob/v1.19.1/CHANGELOG.md &
    https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/blob/v1.19.2/CHANGELOG.md .
    Some of the highlights include:
      - Gleam can now generate Erlang abstract forms, making the
        compilation much faster.
      - JavaScript code generation optimization including pattern
        matching.
      - The --src-only flag has been renamed to --no-dev.
      - Improved error messages.
      - Smaller binary build cache.
      - Compiling for BEAM targets not creates .app files.
      - It gained the ability to specify OTP application names.
